privacy.title: Privacy notice for staff and guests
paragraphs: This dashboard holds the records the hotel needs to run: stays, the guests who make them, what they owe and pay, the stock, the books, and one account per member of staff.

About guests it keeps a name, and optionally an email address, a telephone number and short notes for the desk. Notes are never exported and are not shown to the bookkeeper. A guest with no stay for {guestMonths} months is anonymised automatically.
About staff it keeps a name, an email address, a role and the record of what each account did, in an audit log kept for {auditMonths} months. A session ends after {sessionHours} hours without use.
Only the roles that need a record can open it, and the server checks this on every request. Ask the manager to see, correct or erase what is held about you.
